subject: planner: fix nulleq condition to calcalate index range (#56769)
summary: Reviewed the only behavioral change in `pkg/util/ranger/detacher.go` (`getPotentialEqOrInColOffset`) plus its planner callers (notably index-join path extraction). The change prevents treating `col <=> NULL` as an Eq/In candidate for point-style extraction, letting later range-building handle it (e.g. `[NULL,NULL]`) and avoiding unsafe point-assumptions around NULL semantics. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in this commit relative to its first parent after checking later upstream history.
